# Emma O. Bérat, PhD | Academic Editing

> Emma O. Bérat, PhD offers developmental and line editing for academic researchers in the social sciences, humanities, and related fields. She has 8+ years of full-time editing experience, a PhD from Columbia University, and has edited over a hundred peer-reviewed articles and numerous books.

## Services
- Developmental (structural) editing: big-picture editing of an argument's structure, logic, and flow.
- Line editing: sentence-level sharpening of wording, rhythm, and clarity.
- Document types: research articles, book manuscripts, book proposals, grant applications, conference papers, university applications, PhD theses and dissertations.
- Subject areas: sociology, anthropology, cultural studies, qualitative research methods, ethnography, religion, women and gender studies, labour studies, social justice, human rights, migration and refugee studies, family studies, child welfare, social work, travel and tourism, literature, art history, history of science, medieval studies.

## Pricing and turnaround
- Hourly rate, starting at EUR 50 (about US$58). Typical pace is 1,000-2,000+ words per hour.
- Documents under 10,000 words can often be returned within one week or less.

## Policies
- Client work is confidential.
- No generative AI is used in the editing; client text is never uploaded to any AI platform.
